stories.title: Baseline (as is)
stories.what_happened: Nothing has gone wrong yet. This is the plan for the coming year, before any disruption.
stories.what_the_plan_did: It serves 99.41% of demand at a landed cost of $21.75M, moving it in 2,693 truck trips. It is held for S&OP review rather than released automatically, because the supplied forecast and the statistical baseline disagree beyond tolerance in 1 planning period.

stories.title: A supplier goes dark
stories.what_happened: The flavour house that supplies Cola Flavour Concentrate shuts for 13 weeks, from day 7 to day 98.
stories.what_the_plan_did: It saw the shutdown coming and bought 7,911 L of cola flavour concentrate in the week before it (it would normally buy 400 L), bought 0 L while the vendor was shut, and carried on afterwards. Service held at 99.41%.

stories.title: A road closes
stories.what_happened: The road from Ashford Bottling to DC Alpha closes for two weeks, from day 7 to day 21.
stories.what_the_plan_did: It filled DC Alpha up before the road closed — 41 trucks in the first week, against 12 normally — sent 0 while it was shut, and rebuilt stock afterwards with 90 trucks in the following three weeks, against 60. Service held at 99.41%.

stories.title: A key account's promotion order
stories.what_happened: Ashford Grocers, the highest-priority account, places a promotion order for an extra 125k cases of Classic Cola, due on day 10.
stories.what_the_plan_did: Ashford Grocers were filled at 100.0%. The network absorbed it without anyone else going short.

takeaways.message: Acting ahead wins back $5.87M, 100% of the $5.88M hit.
takeaways.case: Found out on day 7, a supplier goes dark costs $5.88M of profit and service falls to 75.78%. Acting ahead wins back $5.87M, 100% of the $5.88M hit.
calc: Profit a year: baseline $27,091,647; found out on day 7 $21,216,085; acted ahead $27,084,375.
Hit of finding out late = baseline − found out late = $27,091,647 − $21,216,085 = $5,875,562.
Won back by acting ahead = acted ahead − found out late = $27,084,375 − $21,216,085 = $5,868,290.
Share won back = $5,868,290 ÷ $5,875,562 = 99.9%: the $7,272 left is inside the ±$122,258, so the page says all of it.
Read against the ±$122,258 the plans are proven to: a finding.
Orders served, by value: baseline 99.41%, found out late 75.78%, acted ahead 99.41%.
ahead_costs: Against finding out late, acting ahead brings in revenue +$11.61M and spends: raw materials and packaging +$4.55M; production +$736k; warehousing +$49k; capital tied up in stock +$8,737; transport, toll included +$358k; carbon price +$34k. Net on profit: +$5.87M.
Average stock carried (working capital): $444k found out late, $517k acting ahead, $73k more; the capital tied up in it costs $8,737 more a year.
Room to store it: the racking acting ahead fills most is Ashford Bottling ambient adr3, at 11% of its 120 pallets at its peak against 2% found out late; no racking becomes full.
